name: XMM-Newton
summary: ESA's large-collecting-area X-ray observatory, whose deep exposures test decay-dark-matter lines in galaxy clusters and dwarf galaxies.
detection_principle: Multiple grazing-incidence X-ray telescopes obtain imaging spectra, comparing line signals and backgrounds in targets rich in dark matter but relatively poor in hot gas.

sites.name: Highly elliptical Earth orbit, about 48-hour period

results.summary: Deep Draco observations were scheduled to test a dark-matter explanation of the 3.5 keV line; a proposal objective must not be presented as an achieved discovery.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
